subheading.default: Everything you need to know about our product, shipping, and guarantee.

a1.default: Nationwide delivery typically takes 2 to 3 business days. You will receive a live tracking code via SMS as soon as your parcel is dispatched.

q2.default: Can I pay Cash on Delivery (COD)?

a2.default: Yes, absolutely! You can inspect the package upon arrival and pay cash directly to the delivery courier.

q3.default: What if I receive a damaged or wrong product?

a3.default: We offer a 100% free instant replacement guarantee. Just contact our support team on WhatsApp and we will replace it immediately without any hassle.

q4.default: How do I claim the 30-day money-back guarantee?

a4.default: If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase within 30 days, simply reach out to our dedicated care team for a prompt refund.

q5.default: Is this product genuine and original?

a5.default: Yes, 100% original authentic product sourced directly from the authorized manufacturer with official warranty coverage.
